notes.title: About new update of Paste DB and Price change
notes.content:
Good day, everyone!

We have been very quiet since the release of Paste DB. We had some problems and it has been fixed since start of this year. From this year, we were working on prototype of games, building libraries for GUI and many other things. Since some libraries are done, we are going to totally rework Paste DB.

Right now Paste DB is using B-Tree structure, which is great for search speed. However it has a problem with file size and memory for the case where you save more than 4GB~32GB of data,  like more than your hardware can manage. So we are thinking to fix this matter after releasing our few products. So this will happen later in this year or next year.

We are dropping support for some languages and we are going to maintain only English, Korean and Japanese.

For the last, we are going to change the price of Paste DB. We are going to raise the price in next month, October 24th in Korean time.

Thank you for reading this and have a good day.
